title: Poetry 'resurrection' from LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In an era where linguistic creativity is challenged by algorithmic authorship, we pose a provocative question: can artificial intelligence (AI) write an infinite poem? We set up two experiments to investigate the quantitative and qualitative output produced by AI utilizing couplets that evidence a poetic relationship between end words, the only variation in a strict anaphoric, litany structure. Our results show that while AI can generate interesting pairings, it still falls short of human-level creativity and understanding of poetic relationships. We offer commentary and a brief survey of the field of computational poetry experiments, tracing back authorial intention and distinctions of 'natural' and 'artificial' poetry, as well as justifying why couplet form is suited to testing AI's poetic output. translated_title: 从大语言模型中“复活”诗歌
translated_abstract: 在语言创造力受到算法作者身份挑战的时代，我们提出了一个引人深思的问题：人工智能（AI）能否写出一首无限的诗歌？我们设计了两个实验，利用对联来研究AI产出的定量和定性结果，这些对联体现了尾词之间的诗意关系，而尾词是严格的首语重复、连祷文结构中唯一的变化。我们的结果表明，虽然AI能够生成有趣的词对，但它在创造力水平和对诗意关系的理解方面仍不及人类。我们提供了评论并对计算诗歌实验领域进行了简要综述，追溯了作者意图以及“自然”诗歌与“人工”诗歌的区别，并论证了为什么对联形式适合测试AI的诗歌产出。实验1依靠人工提示与共同创作来扩展原诗，并将其发展为一个动画网页装置……
tldr: 本文通过两个基于对联的实验探究大语言模型能否创作“无限诗歌”，发现AI虽能生成有趣的词对，但在创造力和对诗意关系的理解上仍逊于人类。
en_tdlr: This paper presents two couplet-based experiments exploring whether LLMs can compose "infinite poetry," finding that while AI can generate interesting word pairings, it still falls short of human-level creativity and understanding of poetic relationships.
